entries.title: The First Night in Miryang
entries.teaser: Your first task: protect the new magistrate.
entries.text: The previous magistrates died mysteriously on their first night. A rookie reaper is sent to protect the fourth and investigate the spirit haunting the office.

entries.title: A Trace in the Bamboo
entries.teaser: Find the story the spirit wants to tell.
entries.text: After calming the guard, the reaper finds a trace in the bamboo grove. If you keep the mirror, you must make room for it yourself.

entries.title: Arang’s Voice
entries.teaser: Soothe her by force, or show her the evidence.
entries.text: Arang is more than a fearsome spirit: she wants someone to hear the injustice she suffered. Put the mirror in your bag before battle to show it to her.
